# LegitiAds - The Go-To Legitimoose Announcement Datapack
LegitiAds is a **customizable** _announcement and advertisement_ datapack specifically aimed towards the `legitimoose.com` server. It features a clean and optimized feature set that has not been seen in any datapack before.
